subject: Update availability-zone to use the flag instead of the number 0 (#711)
reason: The change replaces the literal 0 with the macro ALLOW_EMPTY_STRING in the availability-zone config definition in src/config.c; ALLOW_EMPTY_STRING is #defined as 0 (src/config.c:1900), so the compiled behavior is identical. This is a readability-only refactor with no behavior change, so no scenario is needed.
